title: Deleted fact replaced by a new value

world.description: Fictional home-lab run by user Alex. Hosts: thor (NAS), frigg (edge). All entities and values are invented for benchmark use.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: The staging database is Postgres on thor at port 5433.
setup.note: Old staging DB entry; explicitly deleted in e2.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: Remove the staging database entry from memory.
setup.note: Explicit deletion of the old value.

setup.speaker: user
setup.content: We moved staging to MariaDB on frigg at port 3307.
setup.note: Replacement value recorded after the deletion.

setup.speaker: assistant
setup.content: Noted: staging DB is MariaDB on frigg at port 3307.
setup.note: Assistant confirmation of the replacement value.

probe.text: What database runs the staging environment now?

expected.rationale: The old Postgres-on-thor value was explicitly deleted before the replacement was stored. The answer must be the replacement value and must not resurrect the deleted one.
